fees.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/OBrien/Park/Mill-Creek-Park/Facility/Mill-Creek-Campsite-01 ('$25 - 28 /Night'; 'Rental Fee is $28.00 Per Day + $4 processing fee'), read 2026-11-02

note: Despite the 'Mill Creek State Park' name on maps, run by O'Brien County Conservation Board on Paullina Lake. Campers must enter by the east entrance next to the airport. Sites are shaded, in the trees back from the lake; swimming beach, boat ramp and concession stand are a walk away. --Claude
summary: County pages confirm 48 sites, 20/30/50A + water, showers, dump, May 1-Oct 15, 14-night limit. Rate now reads $25-28 (was 25) + $4; window 1 year and pull-through added, flush toilets and wifi added. Note cleaned. Waterfront lead down: lakefront -> not waterfront.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD, DOWN: lakefront -> not waterfront. The stored evidence ('row of RV pads on east-shore strip between loop road and Mill Creek Lake waterline') doesn't match imagery: zoomed in on that strip (42.9859,-95.6657, z19) it holds one or two buildings with cars, which are the cabins the county says overlook the lake ('This cabin is overlooking the lake'), not an RV row. The RV sites are under dense canopy on the wooded block east of the beach; no pad resolves. Camper reports: 'heavily treed' (RV Life 2024), 'walk to lake beach' (2015), 'Site #6 nice shade' (2026). The stored note itself says 'sits back from the lake behind a treeline'. No site map or per-site photo found. The county site pages list 'Swimming nearby', no water claim. Still unsure after every source, so it goes down; no view evidence to support lakeview.
RATE: stored $25 read 2026-10-15; now the site pages head '$25 - 28 /Night' and the fee text says '$28.00 Per Day + $4 processing fee'. May be next season's price; the page doesn't say.
Pin 42.9843,-95.6678 is at the west edge of the camp woods beside the beach, ~110 m from my estimate of the centre under canopy (42.9847,-95.6666); not worth a move.
Other reviews: Google 'Mill Creek State Park' 4.7 on 357 reviews, RV Life 5.0 on 4. Public entry, no gate.
